info.name: BPP — Beckn Mobility Ride-Hailing V1 (Legacy)
info.description: V1 (Beckn 2.1.0) ride-hailing payloads from ride-hailing-prod/. BPP callbacks go to bpp/caller so the reqmapper plugin converts them V1→V2 before delivery to the BAP. BAP requests go to bap/caller (requires BAP-side mapper when configured).
